summary: Premium visual redesign testing for AgendaPage and ReportesPage. All features verified: Agenda with premium calendar grid, gradient day cells (today/selected states), legend badges, side panel with gradient headers, monthly summary card. Reportes with gradient active tabs, filter dropdown, premium table with gradient header, export buttons with premium badges, all 4 tabs working (Por grado, Reincidentes, Cobertura charlas, Efectividad). Regression passed for Charlas, Reuniones, Derivaciones list pages. Full-width layouts confirmed (no max-w-* constraints).
